ZT / Current Stock = stock on hand now (Opening Stock).
LT = lead time in months, capped at 3mo (orders are placed on a 3-month buying cycle).
Sales in LT / SH Alloc (LT) = sales and incoming, both measured over that 3-month window.
SH Allocation (LT) = TW-specific incoming from Shanghai stock — this is the real "what's coming to TW" number.
Open PO (LT) = newly ordered qty, shared across all countries (not TW-specific).
Reorder Qty = system-recommended new order (after MoQ).
DOH = Days of Inventory on Hand, shown in months, projected for the current month ().
Crest Grade = A/B/C/P performance tier (from Combined Rating, e.g. "AZ" → grade A).
